_comment: GENERATED by tools/build-sprites.py --only anim from assets-source/new-game/animations. Per hero: 'moves' = texture keys per move (attack, kick, heavy, hurt, stun, knockdown, fly, ko, win), 'left' = keys that also have a hand-drawn left-facing '<key>_L' texture. The legacy <sprite>_hit1..N poses (heroRoster.json 'hits') are always added to 'attack' by RosterConfig. Do not edit by hand.
